market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month settled $101.94 May 1 after touching ~$110 on April 30 (April high, not May). To hit $110 in May proper needs ~+7.9% from current with active Iran/ceasefire volatility. Iran ceasefire optimism is suppressing the geopolitical premium. Some probability remains given how recently $110 was traded.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran ceasefire stability; supply disruption risk in remaining 28 days.
